reason: A DSH visual-understanding plugin that accepts images through chat or a sidebar, sends them with prompts to Zhipu GLM-4V, and returns analysis through the chat agent.

summaries.zh: 通过聊天框或视觉侧边栏提交图片和问题，调用智谱 GLM-4V 进行图像理解并返回分析结果。
summaries.en: Submit images and questions through chat or a visual sidebar, then receive image analysis from the Zhipu GLM-4V API.

capabilities: Accepts pasted images, local image paths, or HTTP(S) image URLs
Stores pasted images on the host and retains them according to configuration
Sends images and prompts to the Zhipu GLM-4V API for visual analysis
Provides a chat tool and sidebar interface for image questions
Stores a user-provided Zhipu API key in a local configuration file
